description: Customer quotes with attribution — for social proof sections. 'grid' layout lays out quote cards 1-col mobile / 2-3 col desktop; 'stack' layout is a single centered column for one or two large quotes.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Section heading above the testimonials. Omit if the context makes it clear.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title.

subheading.description: Optional supporting line below the title.

heading_align.description: Alignment of the eyebrow/title/subheading header block. 'start' = left-aligned (default). 'center' = centered.

layout.description: Structural layout. 'grid' = card grid, 1-col mobile / 2-3 col desktop. 'stack' = single centered column, for one or two large pull-quotes.

theme.description: Background color/tone. Independent of layout. 'default' = page background. 'dark' = surface background with borders. 'inverted' = inverted background for strong contrast.

items.description: Array of testimonial items. Each: { quote (req), author, role, company, image_url, image_alt }.

quote.description: The testimonial text. Plain text — escaped, no HTML.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the avatar. Use the author's name; empty string only if image is purely decorative.

--testimonials-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading, if set

--testimonials-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--testimonials-subheading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the subheading and the content below it

--testimonials-gap.description: Gap between testimonial cards (grid layout) or between stacked quotes (stack layout)

--testimonials-card-shadow.description: Card box shadow / glow (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

dark-showcase.description: Dark background with light cards for a strong social-proof section
